newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: MALBAK FULFILLS CONDITIONS FOR UNBUNDLING.
newsitem.headline: MALBAK FULFILLS CONDITIONS FOR UNBUNDLING.

text.p: Malbak Ltd said on Thursday all conditions precedent to which the Malbak restructuring were subject to had been fulfilled and the restructuring would be implemented from Tuesday, April 29.
The last day to register to take part in the restructuring is Friday, April 25. Listing particulars will be published on Tuesday.
Malbak is disposing of its unlisted investments and plans to distribute the sale proceeds to its shareholders in cash at the same time as distributing shares in its listed subsidiaries.
